parts.text: What are the main risk factors for type 2 diabetes?

The main risk factors for type 2 diabetes include excess weight (especially around the waist), physical inactivity, age over 35-45, family history, prediabetes, high blood pressure, and a history of gestational diabetes. Sources: CDC, American Diabetes Association.

⚠️ This is an educational tool only. It is NOT medical advice. Please consult a healthcare provider for proper screening and medical guidance.
What percentage of people in your diabetes study dataset actually had diabetes?

In the study dataset, 8,500 of the 100,000 patients had diabetes: 8.5%.

⚠️ This is an educational tool only. It is NOT medical advice. Please consult a healthcare provider for proper screening and medical guidance.
I'm a 55-year-old man, a former smoker, BMI 28.5, HbA1c 6.8, blood glucose 145. I have high blood pressure and no heart disease. What's my diabetes risk?

Based on your complete profile, the model puts you in the High Risk category. HbA1c and blood glucose are the strongest drivers; weight, activity and blood pressure are the factors you can change.
